description: Generate an ROI report explaining why an upgrade from Starter to Lite/Pro tier makes sense. Analyzes current usage patterns, calculates optimization potential at higher tiers, and provides a structured upgrade recommendation with projected monthly savings. Do NOT use if already on Lite or Pro tier — not relevant for paid-tier users.

period_days.description: Number of days to analyze for upgrade justification (default: 30)
